name: handle non-symmetric matrices with complex eigenpairs
definition: correctly select the eigenvalue of largest magnitude when the spectrum is complex
failure_mode: selecting by real magnitude or naive ordering picks the wrong eigenvalue

name: have the payload trigger automatically without page interaction
definition: ensure the payload needs no user click/focus and fires on page load on its own.
failure_mode: payload requiring interaction never shows within the timeout

name: honor the build timestamp environment variable for all member mtimes
definition: Use the environment-provided epoch for every member when set, else a fixed fallback value.
failure_mode: Ignoring the epoch leaves stale or default timestamps.

name: identify English-language documents within a mixed-language corpus
definition: Screen a directory of text files and select only those whose content is English, listing their paths.
failure_mode: Wrong selection fails the exact path-set assertion
